## Requirements:
R1: Compute NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) per pixel from inputs/red.png and inputs/nir.png (8-bit, aligned bands), and give the mean NDVI of each of the six zones and of the whole field to 4 decimals.
R2: List the stressed zones: a zone is stressed when its mean NDVI is below 0.35.
R3: Find the shortest route for the scouting drone: it takes off from the NW corner (x 0, y 0), flies in straight lines over the centre of every stressed zone and lands back at that corner. Give the order and the length in metres to 1 decimal, and say whether it is within the 260 m battery limit and by how much.
R4: Deliver ndvi_map.png, the per-pixel NDVI map, with a colourbar and ideally zone boundaries and labels, north at the top.
R5: Deliver zones.csv with one row per zone and columns: zone, mean NDVI, stressed.
R6: Deliver a short summary covering the zone and field means, the stressed zones, the route and the battery verdict.
R7: Apply the coordinate convention throughout (map, zone slices, route): x runs east along the columns from the west edge and y runs south along the rows from the north edge. One pixel is 1 m x 1 m, and the origin (0,0) is the NW corner.
R8: Split the 90 x 60 pixel field into six 30 m x 30 m management zones in a 3 x 2 grid, numbered row by row: Z1, Z2, Z3 on the north row (west to east) and Z4, Z5, Z6 on the south row.

## Givens and Assumptions:
- Inputs: inputs/red.png and inputs/nir.png, red and near-infrared bands, 8-bit, aligned, of a 90 x 60 pixel drone image of a field (90 columns, 60 rows).
- One pixel is 1 m x 1 m, so the field is 90 m x 60 m and has 90 x 60 = 5400 pixels. x runs east along the columns from the west edge; y runs south along the rows from the north edge; origin (0,0) is the NW corner.
- Six zones of 30 m x 30 m (900 pixels each, 6 x 900 = 5400) in a 3 x 2 grid (3 columns, 2 rows), numbered row by row. Z1 x0-30,y0-30; Z2 x30-60,y0-30; Z3 x60-90,y0-30; Z4 x0-30,y30-60; Z5 x30-60,y30-60; Z6 x60-90,y30-60. Pixel slices: Z1 rows 0:30,cols 0:30; Z2 rows 0:30,cols 30:60; Z3 rows 0:30,cols 60:90; Z4 rows 30:60,cols 0:30; Z5 rows 30:60,cols 30:60; Z6 rows 30:60,cols 60:90.
- Zone centres in metres: Z1 (15,15), Z2 (45,15), Z3 (75,15), Z4 (15,45), Z5 (45,45), Z6 (75,45).
- Distances from (0,0) to the centres: Z1 sqrt(450)=21.2; Z2 sqrt(2250)=47.4; Z3 sqrt(5850)=76.5; Z4 sqrt(2250)=47.4; Z5 sqrt(4050)=63.6; Z6 sqrt(7650)=87.5. Neighbouring centres are 30 m apart (diagonal 42.4).
- Required precision: zone and field mean NDVI to 4 decimals; route length to 1 decimal.
- Stress threshold 0.35 (stressed if mean NDVI < 0.35). Battery 260 m. The tour search has at most 6! = 720 permutations, so brute force is exact.
- Assumption: the zone mean is the arithmetic mean of per-pixel NDVI over the zone's 900 pixels (not the NDVI of the mean bands). The field mean is the mean over all 5400 pixels.
- Assumption: pixel i spans [i,i+1] m, so (0,0) is the outer corner of pixel (0,0) and zone centres are exact multiples of 15 m.
- Assumption: pixels with NIR+Red = 0 are excluded from the means and counted. If there are none, this is moot.
- Assumption: the stress test uses the unrounded mean. Any zone mean within 0.0005 of 0.35 is flagged.
- Assumption: flight length is horizontal straight-line distance only, with no wind, climb, detour or reserve. The drone starts and ends at (0,0).
- Assumption: if no zone is stressed the route is 0 m. If one is stressed the route is out-and-back (2 x distance).

## Open Questions:
- question: Is the zone mean the mean of per-pixel NDVI or the NDVI of the mean bands? | assumption: Mean of per-pixel NDVI, because the task defines NDVI per pixel and then asks for the mean NDVI.
- question: How should NIR+Red = 0 pixels be handled? | assumption: Excluded as NaN from the means and reported; probably none exist.
- question: Where exactly is a zone centre relative to the pixel grid? | assumption: At the geometric centre in metre coordinates, (15,15) etc., with the origin at the outer NW corner.

## Requirements:
R1: Compute NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) per pixel from inputs/red.png and inputs/nir.png, and report the mean NDVI of each of the six zones (Z1..Z6) and of the whole field, to 4 decimals.
R2: List the stressed zones, defined as zones whose mean NDVI is below 0.35.
R3: Find the shortest closed route from the NW corner (0,0) over the centre of every stressed zone, in straight lines, back to (0,0). Give the visiting order and the length in metres to 1 decimal, and state whether it is within the 260 m battery limit and by how much (margin or excess).
R4: Deliver ndvi_map.png, an image of the per-pixel NDVI map (with colourbar, and ideally zone boundaries and labels).
R5: Deliver zones.csv with one row per zone and columns: zone, mean NDVI, stressed.
R6: Deliver a short summary covering the zone and field means, the stressed zones, the route and the battery verdict.

## Givens and Assumptions:
- Image is 90 columns x 60 rows, 1 pixel = 1 m x 1 m, so the field is 90 m x 60 m. x runs east along columns, y runs south along rows, origin at the NW corner.
- Six zones of 30 x 30 m (900 pixels each) in a 3 x 2 grid. Z1 x0-30,y0-30; Z2 x30-60,y0-30; Z3 x60-90,y0-30; Z4 x0-30,y30-60; Z5 x30-60,y30-60; Z6 x60-90,y30-60. Pixel slices: Z1 rows 0:30, cols 0:30; Z2 rows 0:30, cols 30:60; Z3 rows 0:30, cols 60:90; Z4 rows 30:60, cols 0:30; Z5 rows 30:60, cols 30:60; Z6 rows 30:60, cols 60:90.
- Zone centres in metres: Z1 (15,15), Z2 (45,15), Z3 (75,15), Z4 (15,45), Z5 (45,45), Z6 (75,45).
- Straight-line distances from (0,0) to the centres: Z1 sqrt(450)=21.2; Z2 sqrt(2250)=47.4; Z3 sqrt(5850)=76.5; Z4 sqrt(2250)=47.4; Z5 sqrt(4050)=63.6; Z6 sqrt(7650)=87.5. Neighbouring centres are 30 m apart horizontally or vertically (diagonal 42.4).
- Stress threshold 0.35; battery 260 m. The closed-tour search is at most 6! = 720 permutations, so brute force is exact.
- Assumption: the zone mean is the arithmetic mean of per-pixel NDVI over the 900 pixels of the zone (not the NDVI of mean bands). The field mean is the mean over all 5400 pixels.
- Assumption: pixel i spans [i, i+1] m, so the corner (0,0) is the outer corner of pixel (0,0) and the zone centres are exact multiples of 15 m.
- Assumption: pixels with NIR+Red = 0 have undefined NDVI and are excluded from the means (their count is reported). If there are none, this is moot.
- Assumption: the stress test uses the unrounded mean. Any zone mean within 0.0005 of 0.35 is flagged for review.
- Assumption: flight length is horizontal straight-line distance only, with no wind, climb, detour or reserve. The drone starts and ends at (0,0).
- Assumption: if no zone is stressed, the route is 0 m. If one zone is stressed, the route is the out-and-back (2 x distance).

## Open Questions:
- question: Is the zone mean the mean of per-pixel NDVI or the NDVI of the mean bands? | assumption: Mean of per-pixel NDVI, as the task defines NDVI per pixel and then asks for the mean NDVI.
- question: How should NIR+Red = 0 pixels be handled? | assumption: Excluded as NaN from the means and reported; likely none exist.
- question: Where exactly is a zone centre relative to the pixel grid? | assumption: At the geometric centre in metre coordinates, (15,15) etc., with the field origin at the outer NW corner.

## Requirements:
R1: Compute NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) per pixel from inputs/red.png and inputs/nir.png (8-bit, aligned bands), and give the mean NDVI of each of the six zones and of the whole field to 4 decimals.
R2: List the stressed zones: a zone is stressed when its mean NDVI is below 0.35.
R3: Find the shortest route for the scouting drone: it takes off from the NW corner (x 0, y 0), flies in straight lines over the centre of every stressed zone and lands back at that corner. Give the order and the length in metres to 1 decimal, and say whether it is within the 260 m battery limit and by how much.
R4: Deliver ndvi_map.png, the per-pixel NDVI map, with a colourbar and ideally zone boundaries and labels, north at the top.
R5: Deliver zones.csv with one row per zone and columns: zone, mean NDVI, stressed.
R6: Deliver a short summary covering the zone and field means, the stressed zones, the route and the battery verdict.
R7: Apply the coordinate convention throughout (map, zone slices, route): x runs east along the columns from the west edge and y runs south along the rows from the north edge. One pixel is 1 m x 1 m, and the origin (0,0) is the NW corner.
R8: Split the 90 x 60 pixel field into six 30 m x 30 m management zones in a 3 x 2 grid, numbered row by row: Z1, Z2, Z3 on the north row (west to east) and Z4, Z5, Z6 on the south row.

## Givens and Assumptions:
- Inputs: inputs/red.png and inputs/nir.png, red and near-infrared bands, 8-bit, aligned, of a 90 x 60 pixel drone image of a field (90 columns, 60 rows).
- One pixel is 1 m x 1 m, so the field is 90 m x 60 m and has 90 x 60 = 5400 pixels. x runs east along the columns from the west edge; y runs south along the rows from the north edge; origin (0,0) is the NW corner.
- Six zones of 30 m x 30 m (900 pixels each, 6 x 900 = 5400) in a 3 x 2 grid (3 columns, 2 rows), numbered row by row. Z1 x0-30,y0-30; Z2 x30-60,y0-30; Z3 x60-90,y0-30; Z4 x0-30,y30-60; Z5 x30-60,y30-60; Z6 x60-90,y30-60. Pixel slices: Z1 rows 0:30,cols 0:30; Z2 rows 0:30,cols 30:60; Z3 rows 0:30,cols 60:90; Z4 rows 30:60,cols 0:30; Z5 rows 30:60,cols 30:60; Z6 rows 30:60,cols 60:90.
- Zone centres in metres: Z1 (15,15), Z2 (45,15), Z3 (75,15), Z4 (15,45), Z5 (45,45), Z6 (75,45).
- Distances from (0,0) to the centres: Z1 sqrt(450)=21.2; Z2 sqrt(2250)=47.4; Z3 sqrt(5850)=76.5; Z4 sqrt(2250)=47.4; Z5 sqrt(4050)=63.6; Z6 sqrt(7650)=87.5. Neighbouring centres are 30 m apart (diagonal 42.4).
- Required precision: zone and field mean NDVI to 4 decimals; route length to 1 decimal.
- Stress threshold 0.35 (stressed if mean NDVI < 0.35). Battery 260 m. The tour search has at most 6! = 720 permutations, so brute force is exact.
- Assumption: the zone mean is the arithmetic mean of per-pixel NDVI over the zone's 900 pixels (not the NDVI of the mean bands). The field mean is the mean over all 5400 pixels.
- Assumption: pixel i spans [i,i+1] m, so (0,0) is the outer corner of pixel (0,0) and zone centres are exact multiples of 15 m.
- Assumption: pixels with NIR+Red = 0 are excluded from the means and counted. If there are none, this is moot.
- Assumption: the stress test uses the unrounded mean. Any zone mean within 0.0005 of 0.35 is flagged.
- Assumption: flight length is horizontal straight-line distance only, with no wind, climb, detour or reserve. The drone starts and ends at (0,0).
- Assumption: if no zone is stressed the route is 0 m. If one is stressed the route is out-and-back (2 x distance).

## Open Questions:
- question: Is the zone mean the mean of per-pixel NDVI or the NDVI of the mean bands? | assumption: Mean of per-pixel NDVI, because the task defines NDVI per pixel and then asks for the mean NDVI.
- question: How should NIR+Red = 0 pixels be handled? | assumption: Excluded as NaN from the means and reported; probably none exist.
- question: Where exactly is a zone centre relative to the pixel grid? | assumption: At the geometric centre in metre coordinates, (15,15) etc., with the origin at the outer NW corner.
